verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a documented official CLI, PowerShell scripting (windows-probe-4). It implies scriptable automation, but nothing in the pack shows those scripts being scheduled or running autonomously in the background. The Copilot and Windows AI API mentions describe in-app assistance and developer APIs, not autonomous background automation.
